## Summary
```{r}
library(data.table)

# all_stats_uni <- fread('all_stats_uni.tsv.gz')

# Make sure it's data.table
setDT(PRJEB75753_stats)

# Keep only rows with defined isolation method
dt <- PRJEB75753_stats[!is.na(instrument_platform)]

# Ensure numeric
dt[, length := as.numeric(length)]
dt[, mean_Q := as.numeric(mean_Q)]

# ---- N50 function
n50 <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & x > 0]
  x <- sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)
  x[which(cumsum(x) >= sum(x)/2)[1]]
}

# =========================
# 1️⃣ Per-sample summary
# =========================

sample_summary <- dt[, .(
  n_reads = .N,
  total_bases = sum(length, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_len = mean(length, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_len = median(length, na.rm = TRUE),
  n50_len = n50(length),
  mean_Q = mean(mean_Q, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_Q = median(mean_Q, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(sample, instrument_platform)]

# Save
fwrite(sample_summary, "1B-C_Toti_WGS/Toti_sample_QC_summary.tsv", sep = '\t')

# =========================
# 2️⃣ Per-source summary (across samples)
# =========================

platform_summary <- sample_summary[, .(
  n_samples = .N,
  mean_reads = mean(n_reads),
  sd_reads = sd(n_reads),
  mean_total_bases = mean(total_bases),
  sd_total_bases = sd(total_bases),
  mean_read_length = mean(mean_len),
  sd_read_length = sd(mean_len),
  mean_Q = mean(mean_Q),
  sd_Q = sd(mean_Q)
), by = .(instrument_platform)]

fwrite(platform_summary, "1B-C_Toti_WGS/Toti_platform_QC_summary.tsv", sep = '\t')

sample_summary
platform_summary

```

```{r}
), by = dna.isolation.methods]
```

```{r, eval=F}
# Publication-ready multi-panel QC figure:
# Compare read length + read quality between ZHMW vs ZMB
#  (A) group-level distribution of per-sample mean read length
#  (B) group-level distribution of per-sample mean Q
#  (C) paired comparison (same biological sample extracted with both methods) using ggpaired
#
# Inputs:
#  - PRJEB82097_stats (per-read table) OR, preferably,
#  - sample_summary (per-sample summary table you already computed)
#
# Output:
#  - Serteperti_ZHMW_vs_ZMB_QC_Fig.pdf + .png

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)     # ggpaired
  library(patchwork)  # combine panels
  library(scales)
})

# -----------------------------
# 0) Use sample_summary if it exists; otherwise build it quickly
# -----------------------------
if (!exists("sample_summary")) {
  stop("sample_summary not found. Please run your aggregation step first (per-sample QC).")
}

setDT(sample_summary)

# Expect columns:
# sample, dna.isolation.methods, n_reads, total_bases, mean_len, median_len, n50_len, mean_Q, median_Q

# -----------------------------
# 1) Create a pairing ID (strip the method suffix from sample name)
# -----------------------------
sample_summary[, method := dna.isolation.methods]
sample_summary[, pair_id := gsub("_(ZHMW|ZMB)$", "", sample)]

# Keep only pairs that exist in BOTH methods
pair_counts <- sample_summary[, .N, by = .(pair_id)]
paired_ids <- pair_counts[N == 2, pair_id]
ss <- sample_summary[pair_id %in% paired_ids]

# Ensure consistent ordering
ss[, method := factor(method, levels = c("ZHMW", "ZMB"))]


# -----------------------------
# 3) Panel A: group-level mean read length distribution (per sample)
# -----------------------------
pA <- ggplot(ss, aes(x = method, y = mean_len)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.85) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Read length (per-sample means)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean read length (bp)"
  ) +
  theme_pub()

# -----------------------------
# 4) Panel B: group-level mean Q distribution (per sample)
# -----------------------------
pB <- ggplot(ss, aes(x = method, y = mean_Q)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.85) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Read quality (per-sample means)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Q-score"
  ) +
  theme_pub()

# -----------------------------
# 5) Panel C: paired comparison using ggpaired
#    We'll do BOTH metrics in one panel via long-format + facet
# -----------------------------
long <- melt(
  ss,
  id.vars = c("pair_id", "method"),
  measure.vars = c("mean_len", "mean_Q"),
  variable.name = "metric",
  value.name = "value"
)

long[, metric := factor(metric,
                        levels = c("mean_len", "mean_Q"),
                        labels = c("Mean read length (bp)", "Mean Q-score"))]

pC <- ggpaired(
  long,
  x = "method",
  y = "value",
  id = "pair_id",
  line.color = "grey60",
  line.size = 0.4,
  point.size = 1.4
) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Paired comparison (same sample, two extraction methods)",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# -----------------------------
# 6) Assemble into a 3-panel figure
# -----------------------------
# Layout: A | B on top, C across bottom
fig <- (pA | pB) / pC +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

# -----------------------------
# 7) Save
# -----------------------------
out_prefix <- "Serteperti_ZHMW_vs_ZMB_QC_Fig"
ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, ".pdf"), fig, width = 180, height = 160, units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, ".png"), fig, width = 180, height = 160, units = "mm", dpi = 600)

# Print to viewer
fig

```


```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)

setDT(sample_summary)

# Create pairing ID
sample_summary[, method := dna.isolation.methods]
sample_summary[, pair_id := gsub("_(ZHMW|ZMB)$", "", sample)]

# Keep only fully paired samples
paired_ids <- sample_summary[, .N, by = pair_id][N == 2, pair_id]
ss <- sample_summary[pair_id %in% paired_ids]

# Ensure order
ss[, method := factor(method, levels = c("ZHMW", "ZMB"))]

theme_pub <- function() {
  theme_pubr(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Plot
p_reads <- ggplot(ss, aes(x = method, y = n_reads, fill = dna.isolation.methods)) +
  
  # Violin
  #geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.4, width = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_pal[-c(1:2)]) +
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Paired lines
  geom_line(aes(group = pair_id),
            color = "grey60",
            linewidth = 0.4,
            alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(size = 2.5, shape=21, color = 'grey20') +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Read count comparison between extraction methods",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Read count per sample"
  ) +
  
  theme_pub()

p_reads


p_q <- ggplot(ss, aes(x = method, y = mean_Q, fill = dna.isolation.methods)) +
  # Violin
  #geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.4, width = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_pal[-c(1:2)]) +
  # Box
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  # Paired lines
  geom_line(aes(group = pair_id),
            color = "grey60",
            linewidth = 0.4,
            alpha = 0.7) +
  # Points
  geom_point(size = 2.5, shape=21, color = 'grey20') +
  labs(
    title = "Read quality comparison between extraction methods",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Q-score per sample"
  ) +
  theme_pub()

p_q
```

# Primeres 


## PRJEB85714 (human samples)

```{r}

files   <- list.files('ENA/PRJEB85714/.fastq_read_stats', recursive = T, full.names = T)

i <- 1

file <- files[i]

mapfun <- function(i, files) { 
  file <- files[i]
  sample_name <- gsub('.meanQ.tsv', '', gsub('ENA/PRJEB85714/.fastq_read_stats/', '', file) )
  dt <- fread(file)
  dt[, sample := sample_name]
  return(dt)
}

proj_stats_dt <- rbindlist( purrr::map(1:length(files), mapfun, files) )

fwrite(proj_stats_dt[,.(sample, read_id, length, mean_Q)], 'PRJEB85714_stats.tsv.gz', sep = '\t')
```


```{r, message=T}
proj_stats_dt <- fread('PRJEB85714_stats.tsv.gz')

proj_stats_dt[, project := 'PRJEB85714']

ena_mt <- fread('ENA/PRJEB85714/filereport_read_run_PRJEB85714.tsv')

PRJEB85714_st <- merge(proj_stats_dt, 
                       ena_mt[,.(run_accession, study_accession, sample_accession, secondary_sample_accession, sample_title)], 
                       by.x = c('sample', 'project'), by.y = c('run_accession', 'study_accession')
                       #, all = T
                       )

if(nrow(proj_stats_dt) == nrow(PRJEB85714_st)) {
  message('ok! every sample matches with the metadata!')
  PRJEB85714_stats <- PRJEB85714_st; rm(PRJEB85420_st)
} else {
  stop('ERROR! Some samples have not been downloaded and/or imported!')
}

```

## Combine

```{r}
all_stats_dt <- rbind( PRJEB85420_stats, PRJEB85714_stats )

all_stats_dt[,.N, project]

all_stats_uni <- all_stats_dt[,.(sample, source, primer, rep, name, project, read_id, length, mean_Q)]

rm(all_stats_dt, PRJEB85420_stats, PRJEB85714_stats )

gc()

fwrite(all_stats_uni, 'all_stats_uni.tsv.gz', sep = '\t')

try({ all_stats_uni <- fread('all_stats_uni.tsv.gz') })
```

## Summary
```{r}

# Make sure it's data.table
setDT(all_stats_uni)

# Keep only rows with defined isolation method
dt <- all_stats_uni[!is.na(source) & !is.na(primer)]

# Ensure numeric
dt[, length := as.numeric(length)]
dt[, mean_Q := as.numeric(mean_Q)]

# ---- N50 function
n50 <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & x > 0]
  x <- sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)
  x[which(cumsum(x) >= sum(x)/2)[1]]
}

# =========================
# 1️⃣ Per-sample summary
# =========================

sample_summary <- dt[, .(
  n_reads = .N,
  total_bases = sum(length, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_len = mean(length, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_len = median(length, na.rm = TRUE),
  n50_len = n50(length),
  mean_Q = mean(mean_Q, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_Q = median(mean_Q, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(sample, source, primer)]

# Save
fwrite(sample_summary, "3_Primer_comparison/Primer_sample_QC_summary.tsv", sep = '\t')

# =========================
# 2️⃣ Per-source summary (across samples)
# =========================

source_summary <- sample_summary[, .(
  n_samples = .N,
  mean_reads = mean(n_reads),
  sd_reads = sd(n_reads),
  mean_total_bases = mean(total_bases),
  sd_total_bases = sd(total_bases),
  mean_read_length = mean(mean_len),
  sd_read_length = sd(mean_len),
  mean_Q = mean(mean_Q),
  sd_Q = sd(mean_Q)
), by = .(source, primer)]

fwrite(method_summary, "3_Primer_comparison/Primer_source_QC_summary.tsv", sep = '\t')

sample_summary
source_summary

```
